verdict.rationale: Algolia documents a public REST Search API for searching, configuring, and managing indices and records, with header-based authentication and retry/fallback guidance. It also ships official API clients in nine-plus languages covered by its SLA, plus a CLI built on those APIs for scripts and CI. A community user confirms driving it programmatically via a simple node import script and a Firebase cloud function. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard discovery paths (all probed paths returned 404), and broader independent hands-on corroboration of direct API use.
